superseded_results.reason: The Phase 3D analysis pipeline has seven identified defects that invalidate its rank and tangency conclusions: (1) the reference tangent span was differentiated from the switched endpoint rather than the original initial state, so it did not differentiate B(gamma,t;q_initial); (2) a common absolute perturbation left inadmissible columns as zeros inside the Jacobian; (3) the reference matrix was QR-orthonormalized without rank filtering; (4) the 'third direction' index was n-3 rather than the fixed index 2; (5) state increments mixed kelvin with mass fractions and were differentiated with respect to raw gamma; (6) several base histories had horizons 0.044 s and 0.064 s despite the 0.1 s label; (7) only a relative SVD threshold was used, so noise-floor directions were counted as real.
superseded_results.consequence: Claim C22 is withdrawn. The reported n_real=1 and sine<=1e-12 tangency are NOT established. These files are retained unmodified as the historical record of what was computed.
superseded_results.retained_as: historical record only; do not cite as evidence
